verification.validation_normalization: Only signature rename/type, refusal nil→NO, and returned checked nodes→YES were normalized.

source_assessment.conclusion: Bound managed DataGrid records are leaves. Early return omits host, generated rows/cells/headers and private editor only from unversioned native bounds. The includeGrids option is propagated through active Workbench recursion; full inspection and separate text geometry retain previous traversal. Dialog publication applies the same native-only projection before its namespace prefix.

Validation decisions are mechanically unchanged. The checked ID map is reused only within one native-owned commit; every identity-reuse decision reads prior state.elements before the first element mutation. Ordinary reparent identity/geometry behavior and strict scoped ownership rules remain unchanged. Epoch, allocation-before-mutation, hierarchy/order and notification code are retained.

All three asynchronous JSON channels construct copied NSData within the producer pool and strongly capture it in the enqueued block; parsing has an independent consumer pool. Perform and TextProbe copy their strings inside a producer pool and use consumer pools; Probe now has a consumer pool. Go may free CString after the C producer returns without leaving a queued raw pointer.

Geometry oracle derives omitted IDs from actual scoped semantic projection, preserves the independent full map and unrelated toolbar rectangles, uses actual routed Grid geometry at 96/120/144/192 DPI, and checks inline editor text geometry plus pending/scrolled/disabled states and one Workbench namespace. Payload fixture mutates/frees its C input before delayed consumption; copy/decode and weak retention/release are checked for small Unicode and large payloads on consumption and discard while the outer pool remains undrained.
Specs state full atomic semantic workload, distinct text geometry, queued-work/native-memory limits, and matched ordinary benchmark requirements without claiming a measured latency gain.

coverage_limits: This review executed no Go/native tests, builds, GUI processes or provider reviews; producer qualification remains separate.

The new exact native-bounds differential fixture covers one Workbench wrapper, but not a Grid inside a Dialog, recursive Workbench wrappers, or a mixed DataTree/virtual table/tree in the same fixture. Those paths were source-reviewed; existing dialog/tree behavior tests remain relevant.
The inert delayed-payload fixture proves shared JSON-helper ownership, not production main-queue scheduling or delayed NSString action/text-query payload consumption.
Explicit pools provide a local lifetime boundary; the fixture does not establish the amount of autorelease pressure avoided, bound total queued work, or quantify process/native/GPU memory.
No performance gain, full screen-reader qualification, or full Mac/P6 completion is certified.
